description: **A `merge` round must name each unnamed workflow path, and the false-positive scan becomes a tool**: W36's workflow rule only warns and the reviewer clears it by hand (`docs/REVIEW.md`); `policy` could refuse a `merge` round that does not name each such path, which asks the reviewer to speak and so does not depend on past briefs. W27 and W36 each ran an uncommitted scan; a host-tested one lets the warn or error split be re-measured Why: closes more of the forged-status residual without the 14 false positives a brief-only refusal has Raised: W36 review, round 1, 2026-11-05
title: A `merge` round must name each unnamed workflow path, and the false-positive scan becomes a tool
